paragraphs: Discover the breathtaking valleys of Northern Pakistan

An interactive travel companion for Hunza, Skardu, Swat, Naran Kaghan, Fairy Meadows, Murree/Nathiagali & more — with live weather, an AI trip planner, route planning, hotel reviews, and offline support.

Safarnama ("travelogue" in Urdu) is a travel discovery site for the northern regions of Pakistan. It combines a curated destination directory with live, useful tools — weather, routes, nearby services, budget planning, and community reviews — so travelers can plan a trip end-to-end without juggling ten different apps.
features: Interactive Map (Leaflet.js) — every destination pinned, color-coded by budget (Low/Medium/High), filterable by region (KPK, Gilgit-Baltistan, AJK, Northern Pakistan).
Destination Pages — dedicated page per place with attractions, hotels, weather, and reviews.

Nearby Services — geolocation-powered search (via OpenStreetMap/Overpass, with multiple mirror fallbacks) for petrol pumps, hospitals & pharmacies, ATMs, police stations, and food spots near any destination.
AI-Assisted Route Planner — pick a starting city, destination, and transport mode to get a complete route with stops, distance, and weather.

Trip Plan Maker — auto-picks the best-matching itinerary tier (Budget/Mid/Premium) based on your days, group size, and budget range, with a full day-by-day breakdown, tips, and hotel suggestion. Exportable as PDF or PNG…
